dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: The Pyro Archon seems to have been pretty busy lately. The Masters of the Night-Wind haven't made any big announcements, have they?

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: Come to think of it though, the Pyro Archon seems to have got everyone searching for a Fatui Harbinger, and there's talk that someone from the Masters of the Night-Wind might be caught up in it all.

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: Oh? That doesn't sound too good...

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: *sigh* Things have been a bit too eventful recently for my liking too.
